title: Value chain reading to artifact
prompt: Here's my STRAT 401 reading on the value chain. Make me an interactive, visual artifact (a single HTML page) that teaches me everything I would learn from doing the reading, without me actually doing it.
context: The full STRAT 401 reading (5,461 words), at context/reading.txt in the run folder (gitignored). Each model read it from that file.
criteria: Concise, but leaves out nothing critical for class prep
No made-up facts: everything comes from the reading
